memories.title: Photo memories
memories.subtitle: Save photos with names and a bit of context — yours or your caregiver's. They show up here for quick recall.
memories.caption: Caption (e.g. Mum's 70th)
memories.emptyBody: Tap Add memory to save a photo with a caption. Your caregiver sees the same list.

live.offlineCaregiverBody: Live signals from the patient are offline. The patient's device may be closed, off WiFi, or running in a browser that's blocking the live-data cookie.
live.offlinePatientBody: Your caregiver isn't receiving live signals right now. You can still use the app; live monitoring will resume once the connection returns.
live.displacedTitle: Another device is now the primary monitor
live.displacedBody: Live signals are paused on this device so your caregiver only sees one feed. Tap to take over from here.
